verses.text: Samson went to Gaza, saw a sex worker there, and stayed with her. 🌃
Word spread among the people of Gaza: ‘Samson is here!’ They surrounded the city and lay in wait by the gate all night, keeping quiet. ‘We’ll kill him when it’s morning,’ they said. 🌙
Samson stayed there until midnight. Then he got up, pulled the city gate doors and both posts right out—bar and all—hoisted them onto his shoulders, and carried them to the hill facing Hebron. 💪
Later, Samson fell in love with a woman in the Sorek Valley named Delilah. ❤️

The Philistine rulers went to Delilah and said, ‘Get him to tell you where his huge strength comes from and how we can overpower him, tie him up, and subdue him. We’ll each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.’ 💰
Delilah said to Samson, ‘Tell me what makes you so strong and how someone could tie you up and overpower you.’ ❓
Samson told her, ‘If they tie me up with seven fresh bowstrings that haven’t dried, I’ll become weak—just like anyone else.’ 🪢
So the Philistine rulers brought Delilah seven fresh bowstrings that hadn’t dried, and she tied him up with them. 🪢

Some men were waiting in the inner room. Delilah shouted, ‘The Philistines are here, Samson!’ But he snapped the bowstrings like flax thread popping in a fire. They still hadn’t figured out his strength. 🔥
Delilah said, ‘You played me and lied. Come on, tell me how someone can tie you up.’ 😠
He told her, ‘If they tie me securely with new ropes that have never been used, I’ll become weak—just like anyone else.’ 🪢
Delilah used new ropes to tie him up, then shouted, ‘The Philistines are here, Samson!’ Men were hiding in the inner room. But he snapped the ropes off his arms like thread. 💥
Delilah said, ‘You’ve played me and lied again. Tell me how someone can tie you up.’ He replied, ‘If you weave my seven braids into the fabric on a loom…’ 🧵
She pinned the fabric in place and shouted, ‘The Philistines are here, Samson!’ He woke up and pulled out the loom pin, beam, and fabric. 🧵
She said, ‘How can you say “I love you” when you don’t trust me? You’ve played me three times and still haven’t told me where your strength comes from.’ 💔
Day after day, she kept pressing him and pushing him with her words until he was fed up and felt like he could die. 😣

Finally, he told her everything: ‘No razor has ever touched my head, because I’ve been dedicated to God as a Nazirite from before I was born. If my hair is shaved, my strength will leave me. I’ll become weak, just like anyone else.’ ✂️
When Delilah realized he’d told her everything, she sent for the Philistine rulers: ‘Come this time—he’s told me the whole truth.’ They came, bringing the silver payment. 💰
She got him to sleep with his head in her lap, then called in a man to shave off his seven braids. She began to subdue him, and his strength left him. 😴
She shouted, ‘The Philistines are here, Samson!’ He woke up and thought, ‘I’ll break free like before and shake them off.’ He didn’t realize Yahweh had left him. 😨
The Philistines grabbed him, gouged out his eyes, took him down to Gaza, and chained him with bronze shackles. He had to grind grain in prison. ⛓️
But after his hair was shaved, it began growing back again. 🌱
The Philistine rulers gathered to offer a huge sacrifice to their god Dagon and celebrate. They said, ‘Our god handed Samson, our enemy, over to us!’ 🎉
When the people saw Samson, they praised their god: ‘Our god handed over the man who wrecked our land and killed so many of us!’ 🙌
As the celebration got louder, they said, ‘Bring Samson out to perform for us!’ They called him from the prison, and he performed. Then they positioned him between the pillars. 🎭
Samson told the boy guiding him by the hand, ‘Let me feel the pillars holding up this building, so I can lean against them.’ 🏛️
The building was packed with men and women. All the Philistine rulers were there, and around three thousand men and women were on the roof, watching Samson perform. 👥
Samson prayed to Yahweh: ‘Lord Yahweh, please remember me. God, please strengthen me just this once, so I can pay the Philistines back for taking my two eyes.’ 🙏
Samson grabbed the two middle pillars supporting the building. He leaned on one with his right hand and the other with his left. 🏛️

Samson said, ‘Let me die with the Philistines!’ Then he pushed with all his strength, and the building collapsed on the rulers and everyone inside. More people died when he died than he had killed during his life. ⚠️
His brothers and his whole family came down, carried him back up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol, in the tomb of Manoah his father. Samson had led Israel for twenty years. 🕊️
